If I was talking with a normal human being I could ask what hobbies she has, but…
There is no way a sexbot has hobbies, is there?
Well, I can at least try.
You: {f_botName} do you have any hobbies?
Bot: Hobbies? I haven’t really tried many things yet.
Bot: I’d love to travel. I think.
Bot: It would be nice to see different places.
Travel, huh? That won’t be possible anytime soon. Maybe if somehow sexbots become legal again.
You: Haha. It’s good to have dreams.
